(1,1), (2,2), (3,3)
Use a parameter for at
least one coordinate
Solutions of equations
involving x and y can
be plotted without
solving for x or y
Parametric equations
have the same form
as points. Any point
with functions of t for
coordinates will be plotted
as a parametric equation
You can plot several
points by separating
them with commas
